posts.author: slimehunter
posts.body:
Hello. slimehunter here. I've made a few games during jams with various versions of RPG Maker in the past and am currently working on a larger narrative game in MZ with a couple partners.
I've been a huge proponent of the tool since I learned about it in 2008. I've tried out XP and every subsequent version since and have loved how easy it is to use and distribute games made with it, and am just starting to get the hang of advanced development. I work at a larger software company during the day and moonlight as a developer/publisher of sorts.
I hope to continue helping with playtesting, feedback, and publishing advice if possible where I can contribute to the community.

posts.author: RaoHolythorne
posts.body: Hey hey, fren! Good luck on your project. I hope your team does well.
